record.question: Services provided is an under five clinic includes: 1. Family planning 2. Prevention of STD 3. Immunization 4. Care in illness 5. Adequate nutrition. Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
record.explanation: Answer C: 1,4,5,3. Under-five clinic services include care of illness, immunization, and nutrition support; the correct code is 1,4,5,3. Reference: https://nhm.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=2&sublinkid=819&lid=219. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
